title: Built, not templated
intent: Momentum's own positioning against the template mills: the parts are commodity, the assembly is the job, and one line has to carry it. Drafted for internal review. Not client work, not scheduled, not published.

plateSource.provenance: Supplied by Dillon 2026-09-09 as visual direction for this piece. Licence NOT verified. Confirm before any use outside Momentum.

palette._source: sampled from the five reference plates; see STYLE-CONTRACT.md section 1

accent.what: indigo cavity, measured centroid above y=700

beats._cropNote: Punched in to plate x300-1540, y0-698 so the plate's own indigo swatch chip (plate y 700-863) is out of frame. One accent per frame: the cavity. Costs a 1.55x upscale, which the soft-focus macro absorbs.

accent.what: the crossing where the indigo strand passes under the cream fibres

beats.copy: One line has to carry it.

accent.what: where the Momentum mark lands — same screen quadrant the indigo has held since frame 1

beats._cropNote: Mirrored and cropped so the plate's own indigo triangle (plate x 1330-1560) is out of frame. One accent per frame: on this frame the accent is the Momentum mark.

card._what: A torn sheet of real handmade paper laid on the plate, carrying the line.

fill._note: Two clean crops of the same sheet, at the same scale as the plate behind it, so the fibre grain is neither stretched nor repeated.
